description: This file defines the CommandPipeline interface in the org.apache.fineract.command.core package, which includes a generic method to send commands and receive responses, serving as a part of command processing infrastructure.

classes.name: CommandPipeline
classes.description: An interface representing a command processing pipeline with a method to send commands and obtain responses.

methods.name: send
methods.description: A generic method that takes a Command of type REQ and returns a Supplier of RES, representing an asynchronous or deferred computation for the command response.
